minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning/Southeast Taskforce/Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, July 8, 2019
  5:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  July 8, 2019 / 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Councilmember Julian Gold, City Manager George Chavez,
  Assistant City Manager Nancy Hunt-Coffey, Director of Community
  Development Susan Healy Keene, Director of Public Works Shana
  Epstein, Assistant Director of Community Development Ryan
  Gohlich, Senior Planner Timmi Tway, Marketing and Economic
  Sustainability Manager Laura Biery, Policy and Management
  Analyst Cindy Owens.

  1)  Public Comment
   None.

  2) Welcome and Introduction
   Brief introduction from committee attendees

  3) Discussion of the Commercial/Residential Interface in the Southeast Area of
  Beverly Hills
   Presentation by City staff
   Discussion between stakeholders regarding residential uses in the
  Southeast: how residential/commercial uses support and impact one
  another; residential uses to support vibrant commercial uses; and
  commercial uses must be sensitive to residential areas.
   Discussion on mixed use development in southeast area.

  4) Activity and Feedback
   City staff asked for residential input from those in attendance. Staff collected
  feedback.

  5) Adjournment
  The next meeting of the Strategic Planning Committee/Southeast Task Force is
  scheduled for August 12, 2019.

  Adjourn
  Date / Time  July 8, 2019 / 6:02pm
